name: click
description: Evidence by default: let the host run normally while Click records revision-aware proof. Opt into Guarded for one human-readable, approval-bound execution contract.

interface.shortDescription: Revision-aware evidence by default; approval-bound execution when needed.
interface.longDescription: Click defaults to Evidence mode: Codex keeps using its normal host permissions while Click records prompt lineage, mutation revisions, exact verification receipts, cache lineage, and an honest completion receipt marked approval_bound false and execution_authority host. Exact same-revision evidence is reused only when repository, check, environment, executable, and host-coverage bindings match; cross-revision reuse requires a committed dependency mapping whose resolved inputs are unchanged. For higher-risk work, Guarded mode stages one canonical contract and the Hook supplies four clear sections—Goal, Changes, Unchanged, and Completion checks—with technical JSON optional. A later approval binds the contract digest and one-use capabilities; in-scope or narrowing follow-ups continue without another approval, while material boundary changes require a new contract. Off mode leaves ordinary work unmanaged. Legacy on migrates to Guarded and manual migrates to Off, preserving existing authority choices; active Guarded contracts remain locked. Click prevents runner replay, tampering, stale evidence, verification-time repository mutation, and incompatible cache reuse without constraining model reasoning or choosing its search strategy.
defaultPrompt: Use Click Evidence mode to work normally and return a revision-aware evidence receipt.
Use Click Guarded mode for a human-readable approval boundary on higher-risk work.
Show Click's technical contract JSON only when I ask for details.
